_note: SYNTHETIC. Written for the Repro demo. No real customers. Account ids only, no names or email addresses. Symptoms are written the way people actually report them: vague, contradictory, sometimes wrong.

tickets.subject: Charged for two tables
tickets.body: I pressed Book ONCE and I have two reservations for the same night. I only want one. Please remove the extra one.

tickets.subject: still two
tickets.body: following up, still showing 2. this is on my phone. iphone I think? my wife says it happened to her too on her laptop but she isn't sure.

tickets.subject: Two confirmation emails
tickets.body: I got two identical confirmation emails for my booking on the 24th. Have I been double booked? I don't want to be charged twice.

tickets.subject: Duplicate booking on the 25th
tickets.body: There are two bookings under my account for the 25th at noon. I made one. The second appeared a few seconds later according to the confirmation timestamps.

tickets.subject: site froze
tickets.body: the page just hung when I hit book. I waited, nothing, so I closed it. did it go through?

tickets.subject: Re: duplicate bookings
tickets.body: We fixed this last week, the button is disabled after the first click now. Probably user error / double tapping. Suggest we close these out.
internal_notes: Posted by a support colleague. Not verified against deploy history.

tickets.subject: Two reservations again
tickets.body: Same thing as last month. One click, two tables. I'm on Chrome on a desktop, no phone involved. Whatever you 'fixed' didn't fix it.

tickets.subject: only on mobile?
tickets.body: my colleague says this only happens on mobile. I'm on mobile and it happened. so that tracks I guess.

tickets.subject: Cancelled one, still charged
tickets.body: I had a duplicate, I cancelled one of them, but my card still shows two holds. Can you sort that out?

tickets.subject: Duplicate reservation (phone call, transcribed)
tickets.body: Caller reports two reservations from one booking attempt. Call dropped before we could get the date or device. No follow-up contact on file.
internal_notes: Transcription incomplete. No reservation id captured.

tickets.subject: Two emails, one table
tickets.body: Got the confirmation twice but when I log in there is only one booking. Just flagging in case it's a bug.

tickets.subject: slow booking
tickets.body: took about 10 seconds to book. felt broken. ended up fine though, one booking.

tickets.subject: double booked on safari
tickets.body: Two reservations from one attempt. Safari on a Mac. Our office wifi is pretty bad if that matters.
